entry.title: Scale the GUI with display scaling and guide AnkiConnect setup
entry.content:
Scale the GUI with display scaling and guide AnkiConnect setup

Sun Valley defines fonts in pixels, which Tk does not scale, so the text
was smaller than before the restyle on a 150% display; convert the theme
fonts to points and scale window size, paddings and the header icon by
the screen DPI, clamping the window to the screen height. When
AnkiConnect cannot be reached, diagnose whether Anki is running, whether
the add-on is installed or disabled, or whether Anki needs a restart, and
show the matching steps with buttons to copy the add-on code 2055492159
or open its page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Restyle the GUI with Sun Valley theme and add an icon
entry.content:
Restyle the GUI with Sun Valley theme and add an icon

Use sv-ttk with the system light or dark mode (and a matching Windows
title bar), a header with Anki connection status, grouped sections, a
switch for reverse sync, an accent sync button and result tiles above the
log. Fonts use Microsoft YaHei UI so Chinese text does not fall back to
SimSun. Add a generated app icon, bundle the theme data and icon in the
PyInstaller build, and document the GUI and build steps.

entry.title: Add Tkinter GUI and PyInstaller build
entry.content:
Add Tkinter GUI and PyInstaller build

The GUI lets users pick an existing Eudic study list, pick or create an
Anki deck and choose dictionaries in Eudic order, then runs a dry run or
sync on a background thread with progress, log and a confirmation dialog
for reverse deletions. build_exe.py packages it as a one-file windowed
EudicAnkiSync.exe; --smoke-test verifies a packaged build loads data.

entry.title: Separate the sync core from console output
entry.content:
Separate the sync core from console output

Introduce SyncOptions, a Reporter interface and sync() returning a
SyncReport so a GUI can drive the same flow; the CLI now wraps it with a
rich-based reporter. Store sync state under %LOCALAPPDATA%\EudicAnkiSync
(migrating the old file next to the script) because a one-file build runs
from a temporary directory, and start tasklist/ffmpeg without console
windows.

entry.title: Render dictionaries like the Eudic lookup page
entry.content:
Render dictionaries like the Eudic lookup page

Load Eudic's main.css and each dictionary's root CSS/JS from the card
template instead of the field, because the Anki editor strips <head>
blocks when it saves a field, which left viewed notes unstyled. Wrap
dictionaries in Eudic's expBody/explain_wrap/expHead/expDiv structure
with its collapse arrow and entry separator, follow Anki night mode with
Eudic's night theme, fall back to the system sans-serif font like Eudic's
webview, and compare media names case-insensitively so case-variant
references in main.css are not re-uploaded on every run.

entry.title: Read the study list from the local Eudic database
entry.content:
Read the study list from the local Eudic database

Drop the OpenAPI client: study lists, words and ratings now come from a
read-only copy of study.db, scanned without the corrupt cus_studyrate
indexes found in real Eudic databases. Reverse sync edits study.db the
way Eudic does (remove the book membership, soft-delete and flag for
upload) only while Eudic is closed and the database passes an integrity
check, backing it up first and restoring Eudic's header format. The
Explanation field is no longer overwritten because the local database
has no brief definitions.

entry.title: Add Eudic study list to Anki sync script
entry.content:
Add Eudic study list to Anki sync script

Reads the study list through the Eudic OpenAPI, dictionary order and
expand settings from a read-only copy of the local study.db, and entries
plus CSS, scripts, fonts and images from the configured MDX/MDD files.
Dictionary styles are scoped per library, resources are uploaded as Anki
media, notes are added or updated incrementally, and words deleted in
Anki can optionally be removed from the Eudic study list.
